_note: Campaign-map presentation (not gameplay). Lord and hero figures are deliberately oversized (constitution, Art direction: campaign map scale); lord_scale multiplies the prototype commander figure (about 4.4 m to the helmet top at scale 1). min_figure_px keeps a figure at least this tall on screen when zoomed out. Army banners (ui/army_banner.gd) float banner_lift metres above the figure's top, at banner_scale_near (camera closest) to banner_scale_far (farthest 3D zoom), never below banner_min_scale, and fade out between banner_fade_start and banner_fade_end metres of camera distance when zoomed very close.
